description: This file contains implementation of the 'split_module' function and the 'Partition' class for partitioning and splitting PyTorch FX GraphModules into subgraphs, including related utility functions and classes.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents a partition of a graph, including its nodes, inputs, outputs, dependencies, and associated subgraph.

methods.name: _get_attr_from_qualname
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute from a module given its qualified name.

methods.name: split_module
methods.description: Splits a Torch FX GraphModule into subgraphs based on a partitioning callback, returning a new GraphModule composed of these subgraphs.
